ruling: ACCEPT with a qualified version-of-record limitation
question: Does the unread Discrete Appl. Math. 358 (2024) 382-394 version of record of the sibling paper arXiv:2312.08382 (record 361128) block credit for 360653?
answer: No, as a qualified limitation. (1) The credited record 360653 cites arXiv:2311.03257, which has only v1 (live arXiv page, slownim-review-r1) and no journal location in OpenAlex (W4388482187); its Conjecture 1 stands as stated. (2) The DAM body could matter only if it published a refutation or withdrew the conjecture; the works citing it (OpenAlex W4401085938: Boros-Gurvich-Makino-Vyalyi IJGT 2024, whose source root grepped with no Nash or multiplayer content, and Gurvich-Maximchuk-Miheenkov-Naumova Games 2024, two-player) and the authors' later Modern Math. Methods 2026 paper (two-player abstract, cites the GM-rule papers) report no multiplayer refutation, and the authors never revised either arXiv text. (3) This follows the unread-version-of-record precedents (346167, 330264, 332037, 369421, 341850, 333709). The limitation is disclosed in the paper and the acceptance record.
